profile.headline: Constantly evolving to become better than yesterday
profile.summary:
Shondace Thomas is currently a Senior Computer Science student at Howard University from Guyana. She has a very bubbly personality and a great work ethic that surmises in her tackling any challenge before her with joy and dedication. She loves helping other individuals and abides by the saying, “Comparison is the thief of Joy.”

Three summers ago, Shondace interned at Google where she was tasked with making an internal platform more accessible. This internship helped change her perspective on Accessibility and as such, she now pays keen attention to making websites more accessible to the user.

positions.title: Information Technology Data Analyst Intern
positions.description:
● Consolidated 1 out of 30 Domino servers
● Created a blueprint that highlights the process from replication to consolidation of servers 
● Utilized PowerBi to help with the visualization and inspection of the database content 
● Automated the process of updating the team user profiles which reduced the time from 14 to 4 hours

positions.title: Information Technology/ Digital Intern
positions.description:
● Created a catalog of Assistive Technology offered inside and/or outside of Dell
● Suggested and implemented a form that collects data from the Assistive Tech users and automatically populates an Excel sheet
● Created a website template for the internal Product Management sites at Dell

positions.title: Engineering Practicum Intern
positions.description:
- Built a tool to analyze metadata from monitoring systems and quantified the quality of alerts generated by those systems
- Used Go for the back-end development

positions.title: Engineering Practicum Intern
positions.description:
- Worked on an Angular Dart web app to make it more accessible to the users via a screen-reader and keyboard navigation
- Used HTML, CSS, and Dart for front-end development

positions.title: HBCU@SXSW 2018 Cohort Member
positions.description:
- 1 out of 125 finalists selected	
- Attended technology and entrepreneurship bootcamps
- Networked with various Fortune 500 companies

positions.title: Computer Science Summer Institute(CSSI) Alumni
positions.description:
- Earned 6 college credits in Introduction to Computer Science and Pre-Calculus
- Awarded Most Improved Student in CSC 100-35 (Intro to CS)
- Worked in a team of 3 people to create a website that recommends different exercises to freshmen to avoid the "Freshman 15"
